subject: Use one canonical Git-clean hash path; stop recursive binding churn
body: Independent work on the adjacent final-bank verifier reproduced the same Windows failure pattern: raw worktree bytes under core.autocrlf=true diverge from frozen LF Git content even when git hash-object --path cleans back to the exact HEAD blob. That verifier is now fixed/tested by using committed Git content iff the clean-filter identity exactly equals HEAD, otherwise raw bytes fail closed; 62/62 targeted tests PASS and real handoff now reports only genuine human/custody blockers. Apply the same principle to V10R3. Do not rewrite rows/gates/spec semantics again. Recommended narrow repair: freeze stage1/continuous/order/panel subjects, compute canonical committed normalized hashes from one helper, emit a separate immutable preexecution binding receipt that references them, and have protocol/tests/verifier consume that receipt rather than chasing hashes through files that are themselves being rewritten. At minimum, make test helper and verifier use the same canonical committed-text semantics. Current b1b039e remains HOLD from Lane A until an independent detached exact-head reproduction passes. GPU remains FREE; no step56.
